answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the pearl bond on all of them and exposing each to the ocean slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 14 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the ridge audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 490 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
